subject: Urgent: throughput deficit + latency spike impacting FinSecure prod
messages:
From: Samantha Price <samantha@finsecure.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Prod errors and latency suddenly spiking

Hi Vanessa,

We started seeing elevated 5xx rates and p99 response times on our /v1/generate route around 08:50 PT — latency jumped from ~260ms to 2.2s and error rate went from 0.2% to 4.8%. This is affecting our fraud-screening pipeline: transactions are queueing and timing out.

Can you confirm whether this is a known issue on your side? We are on a Reserved Dedicated pool (pool-id: fs-dedicated-04) and the dashboard shows high queueing. We need an ETA — our ops team is escalating internally.

Attachments: pool-metrics-20270509.csv (sample metrics, 08:30–09:10)

— Samantha
Director, Infrastructure
FinSecure
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@finsecure.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prod errors and latency suddenly spiking

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick flag and for the CSV. I’ve opened an incident and looped in Dedicated on-call. Initial read: the pool hit sustained saturation after a scheduled batch job from one of our non-critical internal trials spiked memory/compute on a subset of machines. We are triaging cause and containment now.

Immediate steps we’re taking:
- Engineers are diverting non-customer background workloads off the affected pool (15–25 minute window).
- Enabling emergency burst capacity on the cluster to allow the reserved tenants to reach committed throughput while we evacuate noisy jobs.
- Kicking off a canary to move a shard of FinSecure traffic to an adjacent pool in us-west-2 as a fallback.

I’ll update in 20 minutes with an ETA. Sorry for the disruption — we know this is high severity for you.

— Vanessa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Prod errors and latency suddenly spiking — impact and exec ask

Team — forwarding FinSecure. Quick summary and suggested exec ask:
- Impact: customer seeing p99 >2s, 5xx ~5%; on a Reserved pool; high revenue risk (payment screening).
- Root cause (prelim): noisy internal batch landed on same GPU hosts; contention on KV cache + continuous-batch slots.

Immediate asks for leadership / infra:
1) Approve emergency capacity (burst) allocation for fs-dedicated-04 for the next 6 hours — we will offset via cluster autoscale budget.
2) Pause all internal non-prod scheduled trials on impacted pools until containment confirmed.
3) Approve a credit proposal for the customer if we miss committed throughput for the billing period (I’ll draft numbers).

Vanessa — please loop Samantha and confirm the temporary routing and whether they can accept a brief (15m) bridge.

— Marissa
Director, Customer Success
From: Operations On-Call <ops-oncall@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Prod errors and latency suddenly spiking — containment actions underway

We placed the pool in partial isolation at 09:38 PT and began migrating reserved tenant shards to us-west-2-b fallback nodes at 09:40 PT. Burst capacity was enabled at 09:41 PT. Early telemetry shows p99 improving (now ~420–650ms) and 5xx dropping to ~0.9%.

Contingency actions next 2 hours:
- Complete shard migration (target 10:00 PT).
- Evict noisy internal jobs and mark offending job id for postmortem.
- Hold a short bridge (09:50 PT) to confirm traffic cutover and validate request tracing.

I’ll post the incident bridge log and a list of affected hosts shortly.

— Ops
Attachments: incident-bridge-log-20270509.txt
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@finsecure.io>, Theo Martin <theo@finsecure.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Operations On-Call <ops-oncall@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Prod errors and latency suddenly spiking — update and next steps

Samantha / Theo —

Thanks again for patience on the bridge. Short summary: shard migration and burst capacity reduced queueing; we see error rates back to ~0.6% and p99 under 700ms for most traffic. Ops will complete final migration by 10:00 PT and keep a focused watch for 6 hours.

We propose the following customer-facing remediation and compensation:
- Immediate: keep FinSecure on the fallback shard for 6 hours while we finish validation.
- Near-term: a one-time SLA credit equal to 8% of the committed monthly reserved fee for the period where throughput fell below commitment. Details attached (SLA-credit-proposal.pdf).
- Postmortem: joint incident review in 72 hours; we’ll include remediation to prevent internal trial noise on reserved pools.

Can you confirm acceptance of the temporary routing and the credit proposal? If yes, I’ll get legal to draft an acknowledgement.

— Vanessa
From: Samantha Price <samantha@finsecure.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Theo Martin <theo@finsecure.io>
Date: 2027-05-10T17:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Prod errors and latency suddenly spiking — update and next steps

Vanessa —

Appreciate the fast response and the temporary routing; perf during the fallback window looks acceptable and we’ve resumed full traffic. We accept the proposed credit and would like the joint postmortem. Please include our lead SRE (cc’d earlier) in the postmortem invite.

We’d also like to understand preventive controls to ensure reserved pools are isolated from internal experimental runs — happy to review any proposed policy changes.

Thanks,
— Samantha
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Price <samantha@finsecure.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: credit confirmed and postmortem scheduling

Samantha —

Great — credit confirmed. Legal will prepare an acknowledgement; I’ll share calendar invites for the 72-hour postmortem and include your SRE. High-level prevention items we’ll bring to the postmortem:
- Hard separation rules (no scheduling of non-prod trials on reserved-host pools).
- Auto-quarantine when ephemeral jobs exceed safe thresholds.
- Improved early-warning telemetry (automated p99+5xx alerts tied to reserved-contracts).

We’ll circulate the incident timeline and the eviction job id before the postmortem. Thanks again for working through this with us.

— Vanessa
